field_principles.carnot_ensemble_auroc_on_corpus: BARE FLOAT - the in-band gate; the scissor reads this off disk. Must be >=0.65 for the corpus to be usable.
field_principles.corpus_path: Where the scissor reads the corpus from (data/in_distribution_error_corpus_v1.json).
field_principles.frac_synthetic: Provenance - fraction of all emitted rows that were generated, with generated errors also constrained below 40% of the error class.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Verifier-scoring methodology - CPU Carnot scoring against cached FoVer rows, without live model runtime claims.
field_principles.n_incorrect_steps: Set-B size budget - the residual scissor CI is meaningful only at >=100 errors; this task requires >=150.
field_principles.n_total_items: Provenance - records the balanced corpus size on disk.
field_principles.per_item_ensemble_scores_path: Persist per-item ensemble scores so the scissor reuses them.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Verifier-scoring methodology - carnot.verify import plus local FoVer JSON preflight before scoring.
field_principles.random_seed: Verifier-scoring methodology - deterministic corpus balancing seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Verifier-scoring methodology - checksum over corpus identity, scores, seeds, and gates.
